Templates

Start from a template

Pick a starter board and Driftlane will load it into your workspace — columns, cards, labels and all. Loading a template replaces your current board (export first if you want to keep it).

Build your own instead

Templates are just starting points. On the board you can rename and reorder columns, set WIP limits, add labels and assignees, and the whole thing autosaves to your browser. Want a clean slate? Load any template, then delete the columns you don't need.
